title: EU AI Act Annex IV technical documentation evidence
description: Clone-side evidence file capturing the nine Annex IV sections of EU AI Act technical documentation. Advisory only: presence of a section is a documentation-readiness signal, NOT a conformity assessment (Article 43). The kit does not certify any field. Added in Cycle 2 (PR-21).

general_description.description: Annex IV section 1 — intended purpose, developer, system version.

development_design.description: Annex IV section 2 — development process, design choices, training/validation/test data description.

monitoring_control.description: Annex IV section 3 — monitoring, functioning, and control of the AI system.

performance_metrics.description: Annex IV section 4 — performance metrics, accuracy, robustness, and known limitations.

risk_management.description: Annex IV section 5 — risk management system per Article 9.

cybersecurity_measures.description: Annex IV section 6 — cybersecurity measures protecting the AI system.

lifecycle_changes.description: Annex IV section 7 — changes made through the system's lifecycle.

applied_standards.description: Annex IV section 7 — list of harmonised standards applied (e.g. prEN 18286).

eu_declaration_of_conformity.description: Annex IV — copy of the EU declaration of conformity.

post_market_monitoring_plan.description: Annex IV section 8 — post-market monitoring plan.
